articles.title: HSBC cuts Beiersdorf on slowing Nivea sales, limited margin upside
articles.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC downgraded Beiersdorf to "hold" from "buy" on Monday, cutting its price target to €88 from €90 as slowing Nivea sales to shoppers raised doubts over the German consumer goods maker’s growth prospects in 2027.

articles.title: Goldman bearish on Beiersdorf as Nivea faces tougher competition
